summary:
Netflix’s “N” is the icon netflix.com serves for the streaming homepage. Preview boxes scale that file in the browser. The dimension column is the size stored in the file, not the CSS preview size.

Checked 12 November 2026 against netflix.com. HTML came from https://www.netflix.com/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: shortcut icon → https://assets.nflxext.com/us/ffe/siteui/common/icons/nficon2023.ico; apple-touch-icon → https://assets.nflxext.com/us/ffe/siteui/common/icons/nficon2016.png.

The favicon.ico URL is https://assets.nflxext.com/us/ffe/siteui/common/icons/nficon2023.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 9854 bytes. Directory sizes: 48×48.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://assets.nflxext.com/us/ffe/siteui/common/icons/nficon2016.png, measured at 64×64 png.

Brand colour #bb0011 comes from the most common non-white pixel in png-64x64-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: png-64x64-01.png at 64×64 (png, 1755 bytes) from https://assets.nflxext.com/us/ffe/siteui/common/icons/nficon2016.png.
